notes.title: Introducing The Transylvania Adventure of Simon Quest!
notes.content:
From Programancer, the developer of [i][b]Prison City[/b][/i] and [i][b]Dumpy & Bumpy[/b][/i], comes a brand new game: 
[h3][b]The Transylvania Adventure of Simon Quest![/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29892260/17d018457265d1b21b491d3bc5fa6d3c4c360eed.gif[/img]

[h3]You’re supposed to be the hero, but your spotlight was taken away![/h3]
Rival Stan Helsing defeated Dracula first, now Simon Quest must embark on a journey of retribution to raise the Count from the dead piece-by-piece, slay him, and obtain the glory he deserves!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29892260/e177be3fc6432b1c6b3f3194f7a5233e4265b8bd.png[/img]
[h3]Go on a perilous journey through the world of Transylvania. 
Explore dark mansions, discover minigames, and collect different parts of Dracula to raise him from the dead…then kill him![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29892260/d85a1818fad2a0834abc5f7aea3a7be4f6fe0d19.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29892260/20a7583f60581d1a50e3ce60fd060b1742ee5b37.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29892260/e48d165cfd87ad404ccaff90661f2a4cdfe3fe46.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29892260/55d3a3740022272187c588f027fe58f67610f138.png[/img]
[h3]Create different equipment chains and customize your experience with a host of adjustable settings![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29892260/871811dac65663c3e87756e519a388e3126f411a.png[/img]
[h3]Wanna take a break from your journey? Enjoy a fine platter of minigames that include: Memory, Fishing, Crabbin Races, Crane Game, and even some Launch Surfing![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29892260/3d2b93c44d1d20359440f2ddcf96f1420540c657.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29892260/6e9372e099e0caf4053fb3c662a2a050f4c8a213.png[/img]
[h3]We’re excited to announce this new project in development with Programancer![/h3]

[h3][b]AND[/b], if you’re itching to get your hands on playing a preview of [b]The Transylvania Adventure of Simon Quest (TASQ)[/b], YOU CAN at MAGFest 2024 at the National Harbor from Jan. 18 - Jan. 21![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29892260/4ae75f2a4248160f07d34ebfc00650448d5cb1d6.png[/img]
[h3]Look for the Retroware booths in the MIDDLE of the MIVS hall! We’ll also be featuring [i][b]Toxic Crusaders[/b][/i] right next to our TASQ booth, so be sure to stop by both![/h3]

[h3]We can’t wait to have players take their first dive into [i]The Transylvania Adventure of Simon Quest (TASQ)[/i]! Look forward to even more![/h3]

[h3][b]WISHLIST NOW![/b][/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2749920/The_Transylvania_Adventure_of_Simon_Quest/

Be sure to follow Retroware’s publisher page to stay up-to-date on all our games, news, and more!

https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/retroware

notes.title: Patch 2.0.3.4
notes.content:
A very minor patch in preparation for this weekend's speedrun tournament.

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Workaround: In rare circumstances the urchin at the end of Prickletack Pond could despawn itself. As a workaround for the tournament, if this happens the Manaroc Shard will now spawn in automatically at 13 seconds in the boss room or later. This will be fixed properly in the next major patch.
[*] Fixed: The secret code was not displayed when playing the game in German language.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 2.0.3.3
notes.content:
Thanks to all the players who provided early feedback on Discord. A quick patch with a few QoL features and some fixes :)

[h3]Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Speedrun timer now continues to run on the menu and map
[*] Speedrun timer now shows an individual level timer
[/list]

[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] The combo-crystal puzzle in Ice Slide Glide has been redesigned to stop players misinterpreting the solution.
[*] A manaroc block has been added to the challenge at the end of Thrust Jump Jeopardy to help players find the solution.
[*] In Hardcore difficulty, blocks which contained hearts on easier difficulties now appears as solid empty blocks instead of breakable blocks. This was misleading players into thinking secrets were nearby.
[*] Off-screen seeds in Sploding Seeds now have an arrow indicator
[*] Minor tweaks to a few levels
[*] Ice Shard Missiles on Ancient Armaments now despawn if you enter a room and one is near Fia.
[*] Sound effects no longer play on repeat when stationary on the Twist map screen.
[*] The clinking cog sound effect of falling platforms is no long audible when in other rooms.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed: It was not possible to gain a gold medal on Ribbilick Ruins. The coin requirement has been lowered.
[*] Fixed: The game soft-locks when health reaches zero in lava, when trapped beneath a platform.
[*] Fixed: The game could occaisional crash on first load due to an issue creating the config.ini file.
[*] Fixed: Spamming different feather selection when flying through a room exit could cause Kusako to teleport backwards in Flying Solo.
[*] Fixed: Kusako could clip inside the terrain when taking damage in Flying Solo.
[*] Fixed: Manaroc Twist Shards could be bounced around by explosions, causing them to land in inaccessible areas.
[*] Fixed: Sometimes new paths appeared offset after beating a level and returning to the map screen.
[/list]

notes.title: Eagle Island Summer Solstice Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone, welcome to the Eagle Island Summer Solstice Update!

I've been paying close attention to reviews and feedback, and challenged myself to create this update fixing all of the key issues players had with the game! Here's a fun video showing the update's features. If you stick around for the end, you'll get a preview of what's coming next!

[previewyoutube=2Pg3S9wGO5Q;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Revamped player control[/h2]
You said Quill's movement was too slippery and unresponsive. I originally wanted Quill to feel like a retro game character, but this clashed with many players' expectation of an indie game. I've now increased Quill's acceleration (so he's not slippery) and added a skidding animation with dust clouds, making him feel more grounded. His air acceleration has also been increased to give greater control while jumping (a bit less Simon Belmont!)

You also said Koji took too long to recover after missing a shot - this recovery time has been significantly reduced.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29892260/873f7a4116916264d4e5709ced650df47eb2c9fb.gif[/img]

[h2]Revamped aiming system[/h2]
You said aiming Koji was too difficult and the 8 direction aiming felt bad. I've reprogrammed the entire aiming system making it more responsive - for both keyboard and gamepad. I removed a feature which snaps the direction you aim back to horizontal - this was causing many players to inadvertently launch Koji horizontally when they didn't want to. The game now defaults to 360 aiming when using a gamepad, and has a new (optional) aiming guide to keep your aim true! If you want to use 360 aiming without a gamepad, you can either enable mouse control or use the auto aim accessibility feature.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29892260/4e10cdfc4ba83278dae617ad193687fd0c1104a3.gif[/img]

[h2]New runestones[/h2]
You said some of the runestones are too boring. I've replaced those ones with 17 brand new ones! I've also buffed some of the remaining runestones to make them more exciting and practical. Runestones now display a life bar on the UI so you aren't surprised when they suddenly explode! As before, there's the option to make them permanent if you prefer that. Toucan Traders now carry an extra runestone in their stock so you get a greater choice at shops!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29892260/ead5db58f1c5d3d0e7a250c54d9f93d61bfe4308.gif[/img]

[h2]Damage and checkpoints[/h2]
You said the game is too hard and should have checkpoints to respawn at. It's traditional in a roguelite to restart a run from the beginning if you fail, but I totally understand that many players don't like that. Now you can enable respawning and simply start from the last fast travel statue you activated! There's also the option to completely disable taking damage. These options are available on all difficulty settings and can be enabled/disabled on the fly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29892260/8e96460b19267c3a057f7377b122cc042f68f844.gif[/img]

[h2]Effects and graphics[/h2]
Koji's had a bit of a graphical update with a smoother turning around animation and a much bouncier squishy impact animation! Fire, lightning and ice effects have all been greatly improved - the game is much flashier now.

Thanks to you all for playing, and stay tuned for more big news coming soon!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.8.4 - Minor “Free-For-Owl” Fixes
notes.content:
Thank you all for trying out the recent feature patch -- aptly named the “Free For Owl” Update.

Your experiences and thoughts are valuable and I’m eager to share even more plans for Eagle Island in the coming months. 

Make sure to join the discussions on our official [url=https://discord.gg/EagleIsland]Discord[/url] follow Eagle Island on [url=https://twitter.com/pixelnicks]Twitter[/url], [url=https://facebook.com/EagleIslandGame]Facebook[/url], and [url=https://www.instagram.com/eagleislandgame/]Instagram[/url] to not miss out on any of it. 

Patch 1.0.8.4 addresses:
Adjustment: Achievements now allowed with Gameplay Tweaks turned on
Adjustment: Quill is locked in place when repeatedly attacking diagonally, instead of shuffling forwards
Adjustment: Forest Fire doesn't begin in the loading room
Fix: Treasure rooms could spawn off snowboard sections
Fix: Icora’s Wrath could get huge combos on Mantikittens

For a full list of previous patch notes, visit: http://pixelnicks.net/eagleisland/changelog/

Please leave a Steam review if you haven’t already! 

Thanks, everyone - 
Pixelnicks

notes.title: Free For Owl Update: features and fixes!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29892260/24760bd6c520d8f42c6c616f16e32c835ccb57c6.jpg[/img]

From the outset, I wanted to create Eagle Island to be an experience where you can play the game to best suit your needs - a challenge I took head-on to make roguelites more accessible without compromising the genre’s core ideas. So many people have been playing Eagle Island, thanks for stepping up to offer feedback and continuing to support the game since launch!

A sincere Thank You to everybody enjoying their time with Eagle Island. Our Discord community has been growing steadily and just surpassed 1000 members! Our award-winning game is soaring to new heights - and thanks to the community’s feedback, which has been instrumental in the development of this free patch, I’ve got a lot of great ideas for future features and additional content. My aim is to make this the best 2D roguelite platformer of 2019!

I'm adding to Eagle Island’s already thorough list of accessibility options, further allowing players to leverage in-game features for more personalized gameplay experiences.

I’ve pushed a bunch of features, rebalances and fixes in the upcoming patch, including some of the most requested features: 

[list]
[*] New “Lite” difficulty setting - bridging the gap between Casual and Core
[*] 360° aiming option
[*] Permanent runestones option
[*] Store extra runestones in Quill's backpack
[*] Win bonus runestones on a game over
[*] Create a loadout of runestones from Quill's backpack at the beginning of a run
[*] Improved thumbstick aiming controls - for both 360° and non-360° aiming
[*] Revamped difficulty screens
[*] Option to change difficulty level on Game Over
[*] Rebalanced several runestones & abilities based on additional player feedback
[/list]

For a full list of patch notes, visit: [url=http://pixelnicks.net/eagleisland/changelog/]http://pixelnicks.net/eagleisland/changelog[/url].

Thanks again for owl the fun! If you haven’t already, please leave a Steam review - the more, the merrier!

Follow on Twitter: [url=https://twitter.com/pixelnicks]https://twitter.com/pixelnicks[/url]
Join the Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/EagleIsland]https://discord.gg/EagleIsland[/url]
We've got Koji plushes!: [url=https://swm.to/KojiPlushes]https://swm.to/KojiPlushes[/url]
Game info: [url=https://EagleIslandGame.com]https://EagleIslandGame.com[/url]

PS - If you’re interested in participating in our growing speedrunner community, hop into our [url=https://discord.gg/EagleIsland]Discord[/url] and join the channel!

notes.title: Lite Mode Update beta
notes.content:
Hey, I've been listening to your feedback and I've just finished developing a big patch, and it's available now in a public beta. Just choose the public_beta branch for Eagle Island (there's a how-to GIF at the bottom).

It includes a new difficulty mode, Lite, which only requires a 3x combo to earn health. Additionally, you'll be able to keep unused runestones and apply them as a loadout in future runs! You'll also get the chance to win extra runestones on the game over screen depending on how many monster's you've defeated.

I've also added a 360 degree aiming mode for Koji. This is a departure from Eagle Island's core design and may unbalance the game for you, but it's here for you to try!

Why not jump into the [url=https://discord.gg/EagleIsland]official Eagle Island Discord server[/url] and tell me what you think?

All this comes with a whole bunch of other fixes and tweaks, check out the changelog:
[list]
[*]Add: New Lite difficulty setting
[*]Add: Store unwanted perks in the backpack
[*]Add: Lucky Chance on game over
[*]Add: Select loadout from backpack on new run
[*]Add: 360 degree aiming Gameplay Tweak
[*]Add: Permanent runestones Gameplay Tweak
[*]Fix: Spamming change feather while performing double jumps could soft lock Quill
[*]Fix: Urchidna could hide behind large coral
[*]Fix: Keys could sink to the bottom of water before Quill can swim
[*]Fix: Toucan Trader shop items weren’t consistent on seeded levels
[*]Fix: Venom and Potam projectiles sometimes stop bouncing
[*]Fix: Lantern chains could break apart and shake
[*]Fix: Icora’s Wrath could last forever when using Icora Lock
[*]Fix: Soft lock in Armaura battles when attacking from below the camera’s bottom edge
[*]Fix: Graphical error in gold Rattit’s tail
[*]Fix: Oliver’s hit sprite was facing the wrong way when facing right
[*]Fix: The shop button hint text did not update after buying an item
[*]Fix: Mushroom monsters’ gas cloud hitboxes did not match their animation
[*]Fix: Ancient Coin slot was shown, but empty, after completing The Lair
[*]Fix Linux/Mac: GIF and screenshot features would crash the game
[*]Fix Switch: Could not scroll down text boxes
[*]Fix GOG: Achievements didn’t work when offline
[*]Adjustment: Enhanced throw angles when using the thumbstick
[*]Adjustment: Revamped difficulty screen
[*]Adjustment: Option to change difficulty on Game Over (story mode)
[*]Adjustment: Option to change difficult on Win (story mode)
[*]Adjustment: Quill can now run while up or down is being held
[*]Adjustment: Fire Trail runestone replaced with Ember runestone
[*]Adjustment: Volcanic Bomb runestone no longer sets the ground alight
[*]Adjustment: Mushboom runestone explosions no longer hurt Quill
[*]Adjustment: Can now launch Koji while in a ledge grab
[*]Adjustment: Can now hit Burroph’s tail while it is retreating
[*]Adjustment: New Game Plus button now has a description
[*]Adjustment: Time locked doors in Fireside Forest and High Tide Trouble are more forgiving
[*]Adjustment: Overworld map now shows secret levels and ancient coins
[*]Adjustment: Increase amount of items given for Offering runestone
[*]Adjustment: Iframes added after Blast Off and Stratosphere
[*]Adjustment: Quill’s horizontal attack animation speed adjusted
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29892260/5a106792d059a2686a897a8038b7181b38a06a6e.gif[/img]
